title: XTI Aerospace Announces Drone Detection Partnership With AirSight
summary: XTI Aerospace announced a partnership with AirSight to add AirGuard drone detection solutions to its Drone Nerds enterprise portfolio.
body_markdown:
The release lists intended applications including law enforcement, critical infrastructure, correctional facilities, higher education campuses, and sports and entertainment venues. The partnership will focus on helping customers evaluate their airspace monitoring needs, covering drone detection and alerts, centralized monitoring, scalable configurations and integration support with existing security systems, subject to technical compatibility. The company noted that available information and detection performance depend on the selected sensors, drone characteristics, site conditions and system configuration.


Customers can contact Drone Nerds' enterprise team to discuss AirSight drone detection solutions, available configurations and pricing, and Drone Nerds' team will work with AirSight specialists to evaluate customer requirements and deployment options, the release said. It does not give financial terms for the partnership.


## Why It Matters for XTIA


XTI Aerospace describes itself as focused on building a leading platform for commercial and government drone adoption, operating through Drone Nerds, which supports enterprise and government customers from hardware sourcing and deployment to training, service and repair. "AirSight strengthens our drone detection portfolio and enhances our ability to serve the security needs of enterprise and government organizations," said Jeremy Schneiderman, Interim CEO of XTI Aerospace. He added that the partnership "supports our growth strategy by opening doors to new customers and broadening our role across drone operations and airspace security."
